negatives.summary: A frozen-index probe assumed the wrong proposal collection and emitted a null-array error.
A PowerShell foreach-to-JSON pipeline failed at parse time before novelty comparison.
Two login-shell inspection probes exceeded their ten-second wrapper ceiling before returning filesystem evidence.
A Method Flow refresh supplied an unsupported validate --output option after the ledger mutation had succeeded.
The first expanded-portfolio audit found two exact inherited skill-name collisions and stopped before materialization.
